purpose: Non-admission discovery: research permissive global geographic basemap alternative; not geodata admission

entries.name: Natural Earth global administrative geography, public-domain vector datasets
entries.spatial_scope: Global countries, borderlines and major administrative units in generalized map geometries
entries.temporal_scope: Publisher-maintained current datasets; reproducibility requires exact selected release/file and coordinate vintage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m generalized vector data, not cadastral addresses or event footprints
entries.access_class_hint: Publisher states public-domain, including commercial use; verify selected exact release and file
entries.note: Publisher terms https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ say public domain. The geometry is cartographically generalized, not the Eurostat 2024 NUTS code system, an exact historical municipal boundary, a building footprint, flood polygon, insured sum or geocoded claim. Use versioned files and explicit country/disputed-border policies; do not mis-join HANZE NUTS-like codes to Natural Earth administrative names by text alone.
